Nora (Docs): Heads-up 1 opened a tiny PR to tweak SDK snippets: make backoff jitter explicit, switch pagination examples to page_token, and remove legacy cursor usage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978

Ethan (SDK): I can update JS/TS and Go. Quick question: do we want an explicit jitter example or just call out "jitter recommended"?

Nora (Docs): Let's include a one-line code example showing exponential backoff + jitter so readers can copy it. Keep it short and place under "Retries & Backoff". Also fix the bad anchor in /docs/guides/pagination that link-check flagged.

Liam (DevEx): For Python show both sync & async streaming. Also suggest a pattern for retries via client config + library-level backoff so it's clear where to configure. Example async pattern I prefer:
```py
async with client.responses.stream(model="rwd-large", input="Summarize notes") as s:
    async for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.output_text, end="")
```
And a one-liner for retry config: `client = Client(config={"retry": {"max_attempts": 4}})`

Ethan (SDK): OK I'll add a jitter snippet for JS:
```js
// exponential backoff with randomized jitter
function backoff(attempt) {
  const base = Math.pow(2, attempt) * 100; // ms
  const jitter = Math.random() * 100; // ms
  return base + jitter;
}
```
I'll include a short comment recommending server-side idempotency for retried requests.

Zoe (QA): link-bot reported: broken anchor in /docs/guides/pagination -> `#cursor-demo` and an unresolved relative path in /docs/sdks/js-streaming.md -> ../reference/client-config (404).

Nora (Docs): I'll fix the anchor and use full site path for client-config link. Ethan, remove any `cursor: null` from your samples and prefer `page_token` examples for pagination.

Ethan (SDK): Will do. TS streaming example I'll keep simple and show `for await` iterator. TS pagination will demonstrate server-issued pageToken semantics. Branch: docs/snippets/jitter-page-978. Pushing changes tonight.

Liam (DevEx): I'll add a tiny snippets-ci test that runs the JS streaming example in a sandbox and ensures each yielded chunk has `output_text`. Also add a quick test to ensure pagination returns `nextPageToken` when more pages exist.

Zoe (QA): Quick QA note: when showing jitter, mention that jitter values are illustrative and teams should tune numbers for their latency SLOs. Also add the runtime caveat: streaming + KV-cache isn't available on heavily quantized tiny models (e.g., rwd-tiny-q).

Nora (Docs): Good catch. I'll add that to the "Known limitations" on the streaming page and a short migration blurb under pagination: "If you used `cursor`, migrate to server-issued `page_token` or streaming iterators depending on use case."

link-bot: link-checker: 2 issues previously reported fixed in staging branch. Re-run required before merge.

Ethan (SDK): Re-running link-check locally, all good. Pushed PR. Tagging @Liam @Zoe for review.

Liam (DevEx): Reviewing now. Left a tiny nit about wording on the retry paragraph.

Zoe (QA): LGTM on examples. Verified snippets-ci test passes in sandbox.

Nora (Docs): Thanks all ":thumbsup:". I'll merge once CI finishes. If anything pops up post-merge we can patch quickly.
